reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown read 'all the cattle of Egypt died' as widespread rather than total, since Exodus 9:19 itself presupposes surviving herds.

sides.snippet: all the cattle of Egypt died, but of the cattle of the children of Israel, not one died.
sides.verseText: Yahweh did that thing on the next day; and all the cattle of Egypt died, but of the cattle of the children of Israel, not one died.

sides.snippet: command that all of your cattle and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter
sides.verseText: Now therefore command that all of your cattle and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. Every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn't brought home, the hail shall come down on them, and they shall die.\"'\"
